observed_bottleneck: Parent n-6174d6127af5 trains exclusively on clean corpus prefixes, but its own three-seed ancestral evidence shows that this teacher-forced fit does not fully survive free running: pooled complete-conditioned novel-valid yield is 0.825692368639032, and the weakest prepared artifact reaches only 0.7832720190434971 despite all batches eventually filling. Thus the limiting active-layer behavior is lack of exposure to imperfect autoregressive prefixes, leaving roughly one sixth of completed samples outside novel valid support. The checkpoint-only Child n-b992903add3b raised pooled preparation unique-valid rate by just 4/768 while reducing macro score by 0.008551034406275007, so changing which clean-trained epoch is published does not settle this distinct prefix-robustness mechanism.
hypothesis: Apply bounded label-free denoising teacher forcing during corpus-prior pretraining by replacing 5% of molecular input tokens with the existing UNK token while retaining every clean next-token target, so the autoregressive GRU learns to recover from locally imperfect prefixes instead of learning only exact corpus-prefix continuations.
method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.
